incident-bot: ALERT: Synthetic canary 'eu-probe-cluster-3' failing 4/4 checks in 7m (region: eu-west). Trigger rule: canary-auth-errors. Severity: P3.

pagerduty-bot: Created PD INC2468101214 and paged #sre-oncall (primary: nina). https://pd.example/INC2468101214

nina (SRE): ACKED. I'm on it. Any recent deploys or credential rotations?

omar (Platform): We rolled a TLS certificate for the internal API gateway an hour ago, but that shouldn't cause a 401 — that's cert-level. No token rotations scheduled. Will check gateway logs.

incident-bot: probe run id run-20260315T1132Z details: endpoints tested 4, failures 4, error summary: `401 unauthorized` for requests with header `x-internal-token`.

nina (SRE): grabbing probe pod logs and gateway auth logs now.

leah (Support): flagging that a handful of customer requests in EU (tenants: sigma-analytics) showed increased 401s around 11:29-11:34Z. Low volume, but visible retries. I'm standing by to notify if it escalates.

nina (SRE): logs show:
```
2026-03-15T11:29:20Z prober-eu[0] ERROR auth failed token=redacted cause=token-not-found
2026-03-15T11:29:22Z gateway[3] WARN auth: token verify failed err=KeyNotFound header=x-internal-token
```

omar (Platform): hmm KeyNotFound — suggests KMS or JWKS key rotation mismatch. We rotated signing keys for tokens yesterday evening. Maybe some prober instances still using old signing key for token validation cached JWKS.

nina (SRE): checking jwks endpoints and cache TTL for the authentication library. prober config shows `jwks_cache_ttl=12h`. If gateway rotated keys and posted new jwks but some probes still have cached old keys, verification could fail. But these errors say token-not-found on gateway side when verifying the incoming token header — that implies the token presented by prober wasn't issued by our auth service or the token kids don't match. Need to inspect the actual token kid values.

deploy-bot: Detected recent rollout: deployment/auth-service version v3.2.1 deployed at 2026-03-14T22:12:00Z. JWKS updated at 2026-03-14T22:12:04Z.

nina (SRE): got a sample token header from probe logs: `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"rot-20260314-01"}`. Gateway JWKS contains kids: `rot-20260314-02` and `rot-20260314-03`. So probe is using a token signed by an older rotation artifact `rot-20260314-01`. How did prober get that token?

omar (Platform): prober service uses a short-lived service token minted by auth-service via the token-rotation controller. Controller should fetch newest key and issue. If controller still uses old signing key due to a cached signing-key secret, tokens are being minted with old kid. The gateway refuses them.

nina (SRE): quick mitigation: temporarily allow gateway to accept previous key for verification window. I'll add rot-20260314-01 to gateway's accepted verification keys to stop 401s while we fix issuance. Command: `kubectl -n gateway patch cm/gateway-config --patch '{"data":{"accepted_kids":"rot-20260314-01,rot-20260314-02,rot-20260314-03"}}'`

kube-watcher-bot: Patch applied by nina (uid: U542). Config reload in ~15s.

nina (SRE): re-run synthetic checks... first two probes show 200s. rerunning full set.

incident-bot: Synthetic health: eu-probe-cluster-3 recovered (4/4 checks passed). Auto-resolve scheduled in 5m.

pagerduty-bot: INC2468101214 resolved by monitor at 2026-03-15T11:36:40Z.

leah (Support): Customer impact note: sigma-analytics reported ~1.2% increase in 401s for ~6 minutes. No SLA breach but they may have noticed short-lived errors; I've opened ticket CS-3321 and will coordinate messaging after PM notes.

nina (SRE): root cause hypothesis: rotation controller that signs prober service tokens used cached/old signing key material after the auth-service rotated keys. That produced tokens with stale kid rot-20260314-01. Gateway rejected them because it had rotated to newer keys. We accepted the old key to mitigate.

omar (Platform): immediate follow-ups: 1) Ensure rotation controller invalidates cached signing material on JWKS update (low effort). 2) Add a rollout-check that compares token kid issuance vs gateway JWKS to detect mismatch within 2m. 3) Limit acceptance window for old kids to 10m max and alert on usage. I'll open PRs and link tasks.

nina (SRE): I'll document the incident, add timeline and commands, and create postmortem draft. Assigning action items: OMAR-71 (rotation controller fix), SRE-98 (monitor+runbook), SUPPORT-44 (customer comms).

leah (Support): will wait for postmortem draft before sending customer note. Thanks for quick mitigation.

nina (SRE): handoff: oncall cleared at 2026-03-15T11:40:00Z. Leaving follow-ups assigned.
